game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Cold Larder, an ice-cellar larder: the hold guard must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Countdown Recursion: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Cold Larder: an ice-cellar larder
core_gameplay_loop: In Cold Larder, repeat each round: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the base_case value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the beacon fire using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The beacon fire reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the beacon fire is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Countdown Recursion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how base_case changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frozen golems in Cold Larder.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The beacon fire reached with actions_used <= 15.
